'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Scott Lingrell DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Deck name:''' Guri(V) Bahr(V)
* '''Username:''' cslingrell
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
